tools.name: esignatures_list_templates
tools.description: List the templates in the account (template_id and title). Use it to find a template_id before creating a contract. GET /api/templates.

tools.name: esignatures_get_template
tools.description: Get one template's details by template_id. GET /api/templates/<template_id>.

tools.name: esignatures_get_template_content
tools.description: Get a template's body as Markdown, including its placeholder keys. GET /api/templates/<template_id>/content.

tools.name: esignatures_list_template_collaborators
tools.description: List the people who can edit a template (collaborators). GET /api/templates/<template_id>/collaborators.

tools.name: esignatures_get_contract
tools.description: Get a contract's status (draft, sent, signed or withdrawn), signers, signer field values and PDF link. Contracts older than two weeks may return incomplete data. Do not call this in a loop: the vendor blocks repeated polling. GET /api/contracts/<contract_id>.

tools.name: esignatures_get_contract_content
tools.description: Get a contract's body as Markdown. GET /api/contracts/<contract_id>/content.

tools.name: esignatures_get_placeholder_fields
tools.description: Get the placeholder field values of a contract. GET /api/contracts/<contract_id>/placeholder_fields.

tools.name: esignatures_create_contract
tools.description: Create a contract from a template. Unless save_as_draft is yes, the contract is also sent to the signers by email or SMS. Set test to yes for a test contract. POST /api/contracts.

tools.name: esignatures_send_draft
tools.description: Send a draft contract to its signers, who then receive email or SMS requests. Works only for contracts with status draft. POST /api/contracts/<contract_id>/send_draft.

tools.name: esignatures_withdraw_contract
tools.description: Withdraw a contract. A withdrawn contract can no longer be signed, and a signed contract cannot be withdrawn. POST /api/contracts/<contract_id>/withdraw.

tools.name: esignatures_add_signer
tools.description: Add a signer to a contract. This does not send the contract: use esignatures_resend_signer_request or esignatures_send_draft for that. POST /api/contracts/<contract_id>/signers.

tools.name: esignatures_resend_signer_request
tools.description: Send the signature request to one signer again, by email or SMS. POST /api/contracts/<contract_id>/signers/<signer_id>/send_contract.

tools.name: esignatures_update_contract_content
tools.description: Find and replace Markdown text in a contract. Each edit replaces one exact find_markdown string. Set dry_run to yes to check the edits without saving them. POST /api/contracts/<contract_id>/content.

tools.name: esignatures_update_placeholder_fields
tools.description: Set placeholder field values on an unsigned contract. Only the placeholders in the request change. POST /api/contracts/<contract_id>/placeholder_fields.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: esignatures_send_draft, esignatures_update_contract_content · Public sink: esignatures_create_contract, esignatures_send_draft, esignatures_withdraw_contract, esignatures_add_signer, esignatures_resend_signer_request, esignatures_update_contract_content, esignatures_update_placeholder_fields.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: esignatures_send_draft, esignatures_update_contract_content · Public sink: esignatures_create_contract, esignatures_send_draft, esignatures_withdraw_contract, esignatures_add_signer, esignatures_resend_signer_request, esignatures_update_contract_content, esignatures_update_placeholder_fields

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
